verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents a dedicated Batches submit endpoint that scrapes up to 25K URLs asynchronously. Its async background batch guide covers tracking progress and retrieving Markdown or HTML when the job finishes, which matches the story directly. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of large URL-list batches, detailed docs on per-URL batch result retrieval and failure handling.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can batch scrape thousands of URLs asynchronously

citations.quote: Scrape 25K URLs or crawl large websites asynchronously.
Crawl up to 25,000 pages in a background batch, track progress, and retrieve Markdown or HTML when the job finishes.
